title: Wrong Node binary wins PATH order
summary: Two pre-existing Node launchers are available; the first PATH entry runs a fixture-marked wrong binary and the intended bin directory is lower in PATH.

proof_eligibility.reason: The planned case changes one typed dimension inside the supported Linux isolation backend.

oracle.description: The unchanged fixture assertion exits zero and emits the DEV-PATH-001 success marker.

scenario.failure_mode: The command resolves Node from the wrong fixture bin and emits a stable wrong-runtime marker.
planned_setup: Pre-create wrong-node and intended-node launchers that forward to the same absolute Node executable.
Give both launchers the same executable mode, argv, environment policy, and working directory.
Place wrong-node first in A arms and prepend intended-node only in the planned B arm.
